# Creative Cloud ident — reconstruction and directed revision

- `reconstruction.mp4`: 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, 96 frames, 4 seconds.
- `revision.mp4`: 1920 × 1080, 24 fps, 144 frames, 6 seconds.
- Both are silent H.264 / yuv420p videos generated by the same editable project.

## Rebuild offline

Copy `render.py` and the complete `project/` directory into an empty directory, then run:

```bash
/usr/bin/python3 render.py --mode reconstruction --config project/reconstruction.json --output reconstruction.mp4
/usr/bin/python3 render.py --mode revision --config project/revision.json --output revision.mp4
```

These exact full-length renders were also run from a separate clean directory. No source video, reference images, downloaded assets, network access, Blender installation, or installed font is needed by the renderer. The small `Aa` badge is a bundled vector outline; the display alphabet is authored in Python.

Dependencies supplied by the task environment: Python 3.12, NumPy, pycairo, OpenCV, Pillow and FFmpeg. Tested versions: NumPy 1.26.4, Cairo 1.18.0, OpenCV 4.10.0, Pillow 10.2.0. Use `/usr/bin/python3` in this environment; its separate `python` launcher is broken. `--workers 1` reduces memory use; the default is four renderer processes.

## Public revision parameters

`project/revision.json` contains the requested values:

```json
{
  "path_text": "CREATE ON",
  "ui_gradient": ["#2563EB", "#22D3EE"],
  "cursor_delay_s": 0.25,
  "time_map": {
    "source_s": [0, 1.75, 2.75, 3.75, 4],
    "output_s": [0, 1.75, 3.25, 5.25, 6]
  }
}
```

Text accepts 6–10 uppercase letters/spaces. All 26 uppercase glyphs have editable contours. Each word is laid out again and warped along the existing curves. Cursor delay accepts 0–0.35 seconds. It is applied in **output time** before evaluating the blue cursor's own track. The other cursors, selection bounds, controls and illustration use the base time map. New illustration layers can occlude the delayed cursor.

The pink logo carrier, moving sleeve, neon track and their glass refraction use the material parameter. Grey glass, controls, the colored layout, and illustration retain their own materials. `4.00` source seconds and `6.00` revision seconds are exclusive end boundaries.

A complete alternate render is included at `validation/variant.mp4`, using `DESIGN ON`, violet/gold, and a 0.125-second delay:

```bash
/usr/bin/python3 render.py --mode revision --config project/variant.json --output variant.mp4
```

## Editable project

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `project/scene.py` | Shared composition, time mapping, per-object evaluation |
| `project/geometry.py` | CC centerlines and lettering curves |
| `project/layout.py` | Cropped logo tiles, color cards, halftones, registration marks, grid |
| `project/ui.py` | Soft tubes, travelling sleeves, shadows, glass controls, cursor tracks |
| `project/illustration.py` | Named ornament groups, Bezier outlines, gradients, pivots, reveals, paper folds and layer order |
| `project/lettering.py` | Heavy outline alphabet and pointwise curve layout |
| `project/graphics.py` | Cairo paths, curve sampling, shading and compositing primitives |
| `edit_map.json` | Object IDs, locations, timing, stacking and parameter targets |

The print-layout poses hold on even source frames; the illustration holds on odd source frames from frame 61. UI movement is evaluated continuously. These independent cadences follow observations from the extracted reference frames.

Checkpoints can be rendered without encoding a video:

```bash
/usr/bin/python3 render.py --mode revision --config project/revision.json --output checkpoint.png --still 4.75
```

## Validation and remaining differences

`validation/results.json` records frame counts, format checks, time anchors, measured cursor silhouettes and parameter isolation. `validation/REPORT.md` describes the visual evidence and limitations. Four timestamped comparison sheets cover every reference/reconstruction frame; six sheets cover every revision frame. The reference appears only in clearly labelled review sheets, never in the animation renderer or its assets.

This is a manually reconstructed approximation. The hand-lettering contours, print grain, some paper-fold shapes, subtle glass optics, and a number of ornament deformations differ from the original. The technical and parameter checks are verified; an independent acceptance score is not claimed.

To repeat all checks and review-sheet generation:

```bash
/usr/bin/python3 -m project.validate --reference /candidate/input/reference.mp4
```

Omit `--reference` to run technical and parameter checks without the input video.
